name: LTX Tiled Refine
author: Arturogpj
description: Runs the LTX-2.5 Refine Details / Restore IC-LoRAs on 1024x576 windows fused at every denoising step (Lightricks' tiled fusion), so they add detail above their trained size instead of blurring. Supports 2 Phases, tile presets and long clips at 1080p+.
